claim: A host carries a Pi fixture conversation between isolated explicit account folders through the built public kit, restores files and the complete bundle byte-identically, and refuses bounded, damaged, unsafe and existing inputs with rollback preserving the original tree. Real CLI resume, sign-in and other kinds are not proven.

runs.command: bash -c 'd=$(mktemp -d /tmp/byk-conv.XXXXXX); "$FM_HOME/bin/fm-scratch.sh" register byk-herdr-conv-export "$d"; TMPDIR="$d" node "$CONVERSATION_CAPTURE" "$d"; code=$?; rm -rf -- "$d"; exit "$code"'

steps.start: Two isolated account folders and a documented synthetic Pi session, no accounts or model sessions
steps: Select the explicit account using the built host kit against its fake transport
Export one Pi conversation by path and id
Import on computer B and compare complete bundle, manifest and file bytes
Refuse existing, oversized, tampered, duplicate, traversal, symlink and special-file bundles
Fail overwrite after removing an older-location file, restore the byte-identical original tree and remove staging
steps.result: Pi conversation data is carried between explicit folders byte-identically; typed refusals preserve originals. Real CLI resume and other kinds are not proven.

verdicts.seen: I read all 19 entries: 18 JSON records and the final limitation statement. The capture identifies "entry":"built public host export", reports successful Pi export/import with matching digests, and confirms "byteIdentical":true and "manifestAndCompleteBundleRestoredByteIdentically":true. Refusals include "too-large", "exists", "digest-mismatch", and seven "unsafe-path" results. After "write-failed", "restoredOriginalAndOtherLocation":true and "stagingRemoved":true support rollback. The final statement explicitly says real CLI resume, sign-in, and other agent kinds were not proven.
